meta.title: Lead: Biographical dig on five disputed TK judges (Oct 2026 crisis)
meta.notes: Parents and secondary schooling not found in any public source for any judge. All career steps and appointments sourced to Wikipedia/Sejm/press. No conclusions drawn.

korwin_piotrowska.education: Law, University of Wrocław; postgraduate European law (SGH 2004); postgraduate judicial management (SGH 2014)
career_path: Judicial apprenticeship ~1995-99
Judge, SR Kędzierzyn-Koźle 1999; president 1 Jun 2003–30 Sep 2009 (second term 2007-09)
Judge, SO Opole 22 Nov 2006 (commercial/enforcement/labour); vice-president 2012–Dec 2017 (removed by Ziobro ministry fax; ECHR application settled 2022 for EUR 15k)
President SO Opole Oct 2024 (appointed by Bodnar; one of three candidates from judges' assembly)
Themis co-founder/vice-president; president of main board 2024–
Sejm-elected TK judge 13 Mar 2026 (236-185-4); oath in Sejm before notary 9 Apr 2026 (worded 'before the President'); barred from adjudicating by Święczkowski
korwin_piotrowska.family_parents: None found in any source; no documented link to journalist Karolina Korwin-Piotrowska or Janusz Korwin-Mikke
korwin_piotrowska.how_jobs_obtained: Court presidencies by ministerial appointment; TK by Sejm election (coalition majority); oath self-administered in Sejm

markiewicz.education: Law, University of Silesia 2000; PhD 25 Apr 2006 (Zedler supervisor, with distinction); habilitation 15 Apr 2014 (monograph awarded)
career_path: Assessor SR Katowice 2003–07
Judge SR Katowice 2007–15 (presidential appointment 19 Jul 2007)
Judge SO Katowice 2015–13 Apr 2026 (presidential appointment 22 Jul 2015); resigned judgeship after TK election
Adjunct then professor UWŚl Civil Procedure 2007–; delegated to SN as assistant 2007–09
Iustitia: Śląsk branch president from 2009; national board 2010–13; national president 2016–25 (re-elected 2019); remained on board and Śląsk branch president
Chaired Codification Commission for Judiciary and Prosecution 2024–26 (resigned after TK election)
Sejm-elected TK judge 13 Mar 2026; oath in Sejm 9 Apr 2026
markiewicz.how_jobs_obtained: Court appointments by presidential decree; Iustitia by election of members; TK by Sejm election

taborowski.education: Law, University of Warsaw 2003; PhD INP PAN 21 Jan 2011 (Czapliński supervisor; book awarded); habilitation UW 18 May 2020
career_path: UW European Law adjunct 2003– (unpaid leave during RPO role); INP PAN professor
Advocate (Warsaw bar); partner Hoffman, Taborowski i Wspólnicy (left on TK election)
Deputy Ombudsman 6 May 2019–1 Apr 2022 (appointed by Bodnar, replacing Spurek; supervised admin/economic and equal treatment teams; RPO counsel in CJEU cases)
TVP supervisory board vice-chair 2023–
Codification Commission member and MoJ EU-law advisory team 2024–
Sejm-elected TK judge 13 Mar 2026; oath in Sejm 9 Apr 2026
ngos_orgs: Friedrich Ebert Foundation rule-of-law working group
taborowski.international_trips: Fellowships: University of Regensburg, KU Leuven, MPI Heidelberg, MPI Hamburg; Batory fellow Oxford; ERA Trier lectures; appearances at CJEU and ECtHR
taborowski.family_parents: Married journalist Magda Mołek 2011–2024; two sons. Parents not found.
taborowski.how_jobs_obtained: Deputy RPO by appointment of Bodnar; academic posts by university; TK by Sejm election

dziurda.education: Law and Journalism/Political Science, University of Warsaw; PhD UW 2004 (Ereciński supervisor); habilitation UW 2020; professor UW 2023–
career_path: Legal Bureau director, City of Warsaw office; head of process representation dept, Ministry of State Treasury; Bureau of Studies and Analyses, Supreme Court
Prime Minister's proxy for creation of Prokuratoria Generalna 2005; first president 22 Mar 2006–8 Nov 2012
Of counsel Linklaters; arbitrator at KIG Arbitration Court; vice-dean Warsaw Chamber of Legal Advisers; KRRP member
Academic teacher UW Civil Procedure
Sejm-elected TK judge 13 Mar 2026; oath in Sejm 9 Apr 2026
dziurda.how_jobs_obtained: Prokuratoria presidency after being appointed proxy to create it; academic by university; TK by Sejm election

berek.education: Law, University of Gdańsk; European integration study (KSAP/ENA); PhD UW 2016 (Zubik supervisor: Rada Ministrów as legislative initiator); legal adviser qualification
career_path: Senate Chancellery 1997– (deputy director Legal-Organizational Bureau)
NIK 2004– (deputy director Legal and Adjudication Control Dept; deputy director Budget and Finance)
PO candidate (unsuccessful) 2005 Sejm election
President Government Legislation Centre Dec 2007–Nov 2015; Secretary of Council of Ministers Jan 2008–2015 (under Tusk/Kopacz governments)
Adjunct constitutional law UMCS 2016–20; UW 2019–
Senate Information Centre director 2020; RPO Office director-general 2021 (appointed by Wiącek); strategic development coordinator 2022
Chief legislator Employers of Poland 2023; private legal practice

Minister without portfolio / member of Council of Ministers 13 Dec 2023–24 Jul 2025 (Sejm election; appointed by Duda); chair Standing Committee of Council of Ministers; then Minister for Government Policy Implementation to 14 Aug 2026
Sejm-elected TK judge 4 Sep 2026 (226 votes); oath in Sejm 14 Oct 2026
berek.international_trips: ENA (France) study program; 2015 candidate for European Court of Auditors (competition cancelled by new government)
berek.how_jobs_obtained: RCL/Secretary by government appointment under Tusk; ministerial posts by Sejm election + presidential appointment; TK by Sejm election (KO candidate)
